description.text: This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. Major Courses: Political Economics, Western Economics, International Economics, Econometrics, Introduction to World Economy, International Trade Theory and Practice, International Finance, International Settlement, Monetary Banking, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor's Degree in Economics

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Chongqing Technology and Business University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Applicants must be in possession of a senior high school diploma and a level-6 certificate in HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), and be from 18 to 45 years old. The applicant must also be physically sound.
